reporting-org.narrative: World Vision Democratic Republic of Congo

description.narrative: For expenditure data on these and all other World Vision DRC projects, please see the related activity, published by World Vision International (US-EIN-95-3202116-CD)

Goal: Improvement of nutritional status of children and women in Luiza
Outcome 1: The lives of 44,444 children (23,111 girls and 21,333 boys) aged 6 to 23 months are improved and prevented against acute malnutrition in (Luiza and Luambo) in the territory of Luiza
Output 1.1: Awareness-raising, training and demonstration actions, promotion and popularization of good agricultural practices and food knowledge are carried out in Luiza and Luambo
Output 1.2: Seed kits, agricultural equipment and small livestock (rabbits) are distributed to 5,000 people in Luiza and Luambo by December 2025
Output 1.3: Community awareness on Mother, Infant and Young Child Feeding through SBC/Training, production/dissemination of IEC tools, print and audiovisual key messages on food use and information on nutrition and WASH
Outcome 2: Improving the use of the health system in the establishments of Luiza and Luambo by December 2025
Output 2.1: Facilitate capacity building of the health system and personnel in Luiza and Luambo
Output 2.2: Provide necessary equipment to the health centers/health zones of Luiza and Luambo
Output 2.3: Train and integrate safeguarding principles in health establishments in Luiza and Luambo.
